title: BDPv4 + QBrain Implementation Plan, v0.6
description: Validates the data from a single YAML document parsed as a JSON-compatible mapping. Default validation accepts the blank draft template, including placeholders and nulls. Use #/$defs/approvalCandidate for filled planning data and #/$defs/executionCandidate when an approval reference is required. The YAML agent header remains comments. The canonical plan uses an external QBrain tracking reference; a generated copy may embed a read-only tracking snapshot and receipt index.
$comment: Reject duplicate YAML mapping keys before validation. Independently verify canonical ID uniqueness by field, version lineage, reference resolution, phase/slice membership, artifact producer cardinality and readiness order, DAG cycles, QBrain parity, C4/SVG/storyboard files, test coverage, and current approval and HV receipts. Structural validation is not plan readiness or execution authorization. A semantic validator must resolve receipt IDs, verify scope and freshness against authoritative records and derive aggregate milestones. An embedded snapshot is not an approval candidate.

artifactId.description: Stable canonical ID from the owning workspace, not a file path or a version. Prefer ART-<AREA>-<NAME>-<NNN> for new IDs.

enum: <requirements | architecture | c4-model | use-case | wireframe | storyboard | code | test | package | other>

approvalCandidate.description: Populated plan shape before human approval. Passing this subschema does not establish readiness or a passed HV review.

executionCandidate.description: Populated plan with an approval reference. The actual approval, scope, receipts and QBrain state must be verified separately.
